release.release_notes_html:
Wheel-built runtime: karmic-kraken / karmic-kraken-beta

Image: ghcr.io/local-inference-lab/vllm:karmic-kraken-beta-20260922-4d9905b931656635

Digest: ghcr.io/local-inference-lab/vllm@sha256:9625bbc047d3140ce55bb244fdd3ddf1e2911cc5d8ae109e8a5c1a6675dbb575

Native GPU smoke and LMCache checkpoint/filesystem contract tests; model-serving performance and full GLM cache E2E remain unqualified.

Changes since ghcr.io/local-inference-lab/vllm:karmic-kraken-beta-20260922-97197f5085f4798b

Correctness and reliability

  • Align contiguous attention normalization and tuning identities with master (b12x #400, b12x #407; by @acronjob, @voipmonitor, acronjob, lukealonso, voipmonitor)
    • Models: all
    • Preserve the native scale and FlashAttention 2 reduction order in contiguous attention normalization.
    • Share tuning identity across product labels with the same compute capability and SM count.
    • Retain configured traffic class in the switched-RoCE proxy.
  • Validate distributed QSA capacity and query metadata before launching kernels (b12x #406; by @voipmonitor)
    • Models: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
    • Compatibility: DCP plans must reserve at least one complete compressed group on each rank. Valid serving configurations are unchanged.
    • Reject an empty planned local score domain before workspace preparation can divide by zero; live requests may still have no local groups.
    • Check query positions and destination row capacity before global selection expansion writes to caller-owned scratch.
    • Reject non-DCP draft-selection reuse before returning an unwritten log-sum-exp buffer.

Performance

  • Refine NVFP4 decode tiles and expand supported dense and MoE quantization (by lukealonso)
    • Models: all
    • Use compact N16 token layouts and paired input producers for eligible NVFP4 decode kernels.
    • Include half-resident and three-quarter-resident grids in runtime tuning while enforcing the device residency limit.
    • Add safetensors IQ2_XS dense and expert-weight support without changing existing checkpoint formats.
  • Fuse recurrent metadata copies across cache groups (by lukealonso)
    • Models: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
    • Retain captured buffer addresses while copying worklists and refreshing recurrent-state indices in one GPU launch.
    • Mixed batches use the fused refresh; uniform decode graphs retain the separate metadata-elision optimization.

Compatibility

  • Carry canonical Qwen tensor-parallel preparation and Spark launch contracts into beta (by lukealonso)
    • Models: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash
    • Distribute eligible Qwen residual-mixing projections across tensor-parallel ranks.
    • Preserve per-head GDN normalization geometry during warmup and use the declared B12X QSA capacity API.
    • Retain canonical Spark switched-RoCE and DeepSeek TP3 launcher settings.
